messages:
Alex K: Heads-up — scheduling a deployment readiness call with Nightingale for their Private (VPC/on‑prem) rollout. Need infra, SRE, security, and platform present. Proposed times: Wed Mar 31 10:00am PT or Thu Apr 1 9:00am PT. Agenda draft below. Who can make it?

Jamila R: Either is ok for Eng Infra. I prefer Wed so we can unblock config changes earlier.

Trent D: Thu works better for me (oncall Wed AM). I can join the tail of Wed if we keep it short.

Maria L: Security can do either. Please add KMS/HSM verification and audit log retention to the agenda.

Ryan S: I can own the VPC peering and firewall checklist. Both times look fine.

Alex K: Agenda (draft):
1) Quick rollout overview & schedule (Alex)
2) VPC peering, VPN, and firewall checklist (Ryan)
3) KMS / secrets & audit logs (Maria)
4) Monitoring, alerting, and SLO gates for canary (Trent)
5) Rollback criteria & post-rollout diagnostics
Prep items: share runbook link, preflight outputs (network traceroutes, KMS IAM policy, monitoring dashboards). Please claim owners.

Jamila R: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nightingale-deploy (internal). I'll sync and add a "preflight" section with exact checks we want.

Trent D: Can sre-bot create a 45-minute calendar slot and include the postmortem doc template in the invite? Also will add canary gate thresholds to runbook.

sre-bot: Created calendar event — "Nightingale deploy readiness" Wed Mar 31 10:00‑10:45 PT. Invitees: Alex K, Jamila R, Trent D, Maria L, Ryan S. Join: https://meet.redwood/abc123. Added postmortem template to attachment. :calendar: 

Alex K: Thanks. Ryan, can you paste the exact commands you plan to run for port and route checks so Jamila can include them in preflight?

Ryan S: From our edge box I'll run: ```nc -zv nightingale-app.internal 443 && nc -zv nightingale-cache.internal 6379 && traceroute -n nightingale-app.internal``` I'll also capture current iptables and post a diff before/after.

Maria L: For KMS check: run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy nightingale-key --location=global` (verify service account binding) and confirm key ring replication config. I'll add exact expected output to runbook.

Trent D: Canary plan: route 5% traffic, health >= 99% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% if stable. If error rate spikes > 1% in any window revert. Adding to runbook.

Jamila R: Sounds good. I'll update the runbook section names: preflight/network, preflight/kms, rollout/canary, rollback. Will also add a checklist for customer VPN tunnel windows.

Alex K: I'll send the calendar invite to the customer and ask them to confirm the VPN maintenance window. If anyone can't make Wed, please drop notes/ownership in this thread or update the runbook directly. Appreciate it!
